entries.zh: 脱下帽子；摘下帽子放回原处
entries.en: to take off one's hat (and put it in its place); to doff the hat

entries.zh: 强劫；以暴力抢夺他人财物
entries.en: to snatch away another's property by force; to rob
to take away by force; to strip off by force
to snatch and seize by force; to grab and occupy
to delete or cut down (writing) in correcting it; to strike out
to cut off the hair; to shave the head
entries.notes: H 栏「削伐」当作「削髮」，与 M siac huat 相合；R 栏字迹污损难辨。

entries.en: to dispel watery swelling; to reduce edema
entries.notes: L 栏「enso porrizir」讹误难读，义据 H「消水脹」及 M sian chui tio 定。

entries.zh: 为表敬意而脱帽；行脱帽礼
entries.en: to doff one's hat in courtesy; to tip one's hat
entries.notes: H 栏首字「撮」可疑（或作「撤」），L 明言脱帽示敬，义可定。

entries.en: to give back the money; to refund
entries.notes: L 栏末「avicen tado」讹误难解，H「退錢」与 M te chy 明示退款义。

entries.zh: 蜕皮；脱去外皮（如蝉蜕壳）
entries.en: to shed the skin; to slough it off (as a cicada molts)
entries.notes: L 栏「ala yarra」残缺难读，H「蟬退（蛻）」与 M sien tue 互证蜕皮义。

entries.en: to remove a mole with medicine (a caustic)
to remove from office; to dismiss from a post
entries.notes: H 栏首字「點」当为「黜」（与 13、14、20 条同字，14 条「黜陟」可证），L 明言去职。

entries.zh: 革职斥退；罢免并逐出官职
entries.en: to dismiss and discharge from office
entries.notes: H 栏首字「點」当为「黜」，即「黜退」；L 明言去职。

entries.en: to demote and dismiss from office; to degrade
entries.notes: H「點陟」当作「黜陟」，M 末字 ter/teg 亦存疑；L 为去职，取贬黜义。

entries.en: to shake off melancholy; to dispel one's gloom
to relieve sadness; to console and cheer up
entries.notes: L 栏「gritteca」当为 tristeza（忧愁）之讹，R 栏「quitarla: y consolar」正释此义。

entries.zh: 因热掀开被子；露身不盖被
entries.en: to throw off the quilt because of the heat; to lie uncovered
entries.notes: L 栏「spadens che」残缺难读，H「露被」与 M la pue 明示因热去被。

entries.en: to behead; to cut off the head

entries.zh: 唾人并掉头避开，以示轻蔑嘲弄
entries.en: to spit at someone and turn away in mockery; to reject with contempt
entries.notes: L「Qvitarse ay」难解，M chui 与「唾」常读不合；义据 H「唾你」及 L「haciendo burla」推为唾人嘲弄。

entries.en: to strip someone of his office and cast him out
entries.notes: H 栏首字「點」当为「黜」，即「黜丢却」；L 明言夺职并逐出。
